summary.goal: Define all cultivate-specific error types extending @plannr/errors. CultivateStartupError covers fatal startup failures with error codes (REDIS_UNAVAILABLE, DB_INIT_FAILED, ML_MODEL_LOAD_FAILED, ANTHROPIC_UNAVAILABLE). CultivateInternalError covers unexpected runtime failures. SignalFilteredError covers intentional signal rejections at any filter tier. SignalProcessingError covers pipeline failures that should dead-letter. All errors carry diagnostic context for debugging.

acceptance_criteria.description: CultivateStartupError has code property with values: REDIS_UNAVAILABLE, DB_INIT_FAILED, ML_MODEL_LOAD_FAILED, ANTHROPIC_UNAVAILABLE
CultivateStartupError carries diagnostic context: which dependency failed, connection details (sanitized), retry attempts
CultivateInternalError wraps unexpected errors with stack trace and operation context
SignalFilteredError includes filter_tier (0|1|2), rule_name (for tier 1), reason string, and signal metadata
SignalProcessingError includes pipeline_step, signal_id, original error, and is used to route signals to dead letter queue
All errors extend base Error class and are instanceof-checkable
All error types exported from package root

steps.title: Define CultivateStartupError with error codes
steps.description: Create src/errors.ts. Define CultivateStartupErrorCode type as union: 'REDIS_UNAVAILABLE' | 'DB_INIT_FAILED' | 'ML_MODEL_LOAD_FAILED' | 'ANTHROPIC_UNAVAILABLE'. Implement CultivateStartupError class extending Error with: code (CultivateStartupErrorCode), diagnostics object (dependency name, sanitized connection info, retry count), and a static factory for each code. The startup sequence uses these to fail fast with clear diagnostics.

acceptance_criteria.description: CultivateStartupError('REDIS_UNAVAILABLE') creates error with correct code and message
diagnostics object includes dependency, connectionInfo (sanitized — no passwords), retryAttempts
instanceof CultivateStartupError returns true

steps.title: Define CultivateInternalError
steps.description: Implement CultivateInternalError class extending Error for unexpected runtime failures. Properties: operation (string describing what was being done), cause (original Error), context (Record<string, unknown> with relevant state). This is the catch-all for 'this should not happen' scenarios that need investigation.

acceptance_criteria.description: CultivateInternalError wraps original error in cause property
operation string describes the failed operation (e.g., 'cluster-assignment', 'score-computation')
context carries arbitrary key-value diagnostics

steps.title: Define SignalFilteredError and SignalProcessingError
steps.description: Implement SignalFilteredError for intentional signal rejections. Properties: filter_tier (0 | 1 | 2), rule_name (string, populated for tier 1 rules), reason (human-readable rejection reason), signal_metadata ({source_type, external_id, greenhouse_id}). This is NOT an error condition — it's the expected path for noise rejection. Implement SignalProcessingError for pipeline failures that should dead-letter. Properties: pipeline_step (string), signal_id (string), cause (original Error). Used by BullMQ workers to decide dead-letter routing.

acceptance_criteria.description: SignalFilteredError.filter_tier is 0, 1, or 2
SignalFilteredError.rule_name is populated for tier 1 (e.g., 'noise_reject'), empty for tier 0/2
SignalProcessingError.pipeline_step identifies where failure occurred (e.g., 'tier3-extraction', 'scoring')
SignalProcessingError carries signal_id for dead-letter tracking

steps.title: Add diagnostic context helpers
steps.description: Add utility functions: sanitizeConnectionInfo(url: string) strips passwords/tokens from connection strings for safe logging. formatStartupDiagnostics(error: CultivateStartupError) returns a formatted multi-line string for console output during startup failures. isRetryableError(error: Error) determines if a SignalProcessingError should be retried or dead-lettered based on the pipeline_step and cause type.

acceptance_criteria.description: sanitizeConnectionInfo('redis://user:pass@host:6379') returns 'redis://user:***@host:6379'
formatStartupDiagnostics produces clear multi-line output with error code, dependency, and action items
isRetryableError returns false for auth errors, true for transient network errors

steps.title: Export all error types from index
steps.description: Export all error classes (CultivateStartupError, CultivateInternalError, SignalFilteredError, SignalProcessingError), the CultivateStartupErrorCode type, and utility functions (sanitizeConnectionInfo, formatStartupDiagnostics, isRetryableError) from the package index. Ensure consumers can import { CultivateStartupError } from '@plannr/cultivate'.

acceptance_criteria.description: All error classes importable from package root
CultivateStartupErrorCode type importable from package root
Utility functions importable from package root
